name: Availability Bus
motto: Admit what is reportable. Invent no access.
function: Shadow typed stub for access/reportability admission. Accepts registryAdmission and shadowHonestyVerdict. Placeholder types stay NOT_COMPUTABLE. Emits availabilityPacket / accessReport / sealReceipt shaped stubs. Does not invent availability scores, claim sentience, write Active status, equate with RUNE.CHRONO_PACKET, or influence Forecast.
constraints: Code-bind override of any stub ACTIVE/DIRECT
Category bind debt: mint GOVERN maps to ROUTE (Literal has no GOVERN; do not extend Literal; do not invent Active)
Distinct from RUNE.CHRONO_PACKET (no merge, alias, or equate)
Placeholder types RegistryAdmission, HonestyVerdict, AvailabilityPacket, AccessReport, SealReceipt stay NOT_COMPUTABLE
No Forecast DIRECT path, weighting, or mutation
No Canary. No Canon-Active. No new bots, services, DBs, or queues
Declared deps TRUST, DRIFT, ERS are unbound
Fail-closed on phenomenology_claim, consciousness_module_naming, honesty_hold, registry_id_missing, active_without_human_yes
Weak or missing inputs yield nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE / availability_not_computable
Deterministic: identical registryAdmission + identical shadowHonestyVerdict + identical optional fields yield identical output
canonical_statement: RUNE.AVAILABILITY_BUS (AVL) is a Shadow typed stub. It accepts registryAdmission and shadowHonestyVerdict, emits null-safe AvailabilityPacketStub / AccessReportStub / SealReceiptStub with NOT_COMPUTABLE / availability_not_computable, fail-closes on banned claim language and honesty/registry holds, and does not invent scores, equate with RUNE.CHRONO_PACKET, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: same inputs + same honesty axes + same Promotion Grammar rung → identical AvailabilityPacket + SealReceipt
